incidents.name: ChainSwap receive() unbound signatory check
incidents.notes: The bridge's receive() recovered a signer with ecrecover but never required it to equal the caller-supplied signatures[i].signatory, so any garbage signature passed the quota/duplicate checks and released bridged tokens.

sources.ref: onchain review: bridge proxy 0x7fe68FC06e1A870DcbeE0acAe8720396DC12FC86 created 2021-03-13T23:07:57Z by 0xc96ecc8456cd0e5b20c1c40989adad9c1809da9c, unrelated to the attack sender 0x941a9e3b...; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events between creation and the incident, age measured from deployment.

re-check 2026 (deployment-basis rows with a DELEGATECALL in the runtime): CORRECTION, by the same method already recorded for this file's BSC row. The victim is a ChainSwap InitializableProductProxy: its EIP-1967 implementation slot is empty and the delegate target is resolved as IProxyFactory(factory).productImplementations(name), with FACTORY_SLOT 0x7a45a402e4cb6e08ebc196f20f66d5d30e67285a2a8aa80503fa409e727a4af1 = 0xbf515ff38d55737c56d62e8b6a8eea322ec38aa5 and NAME_SLOT 0x4cd9b827ca535ceb0880425d70eff88561ecdf04dc32fcf7ff3b15c587f8a870 = 'TokenMapped', both constant over [12033100, 12751488] (25-point probe each). Binary-searching eth_call of productImplementations('TokenMapped') over the same range: 0x3c894caf21f18f42d8d06daf26983c4b6a32fc1c at creation, changed to 0xec2c74c9e2457d328bc6216858280ea13e740e8a at block 12369818 (2021-05-04T20:09:27Z) by tx 0x2c3d078fcaea7ffe95abd2869ceac68db1b525c5278082d14f88d315ea6d2595 from the deployer 0xc96ecc8456cd0e5b20c1c40989adad9c1809da9c, then constant to the incident (51-point dense re-probe). callTracer on the exploit tx confirms the proxy delegatecalled only 0xec2c74c9e2457d328bc6216858280ea13e740e8a, which has zero DELEGATECALL opcodes. Age 1625272990 - 1620158967 = 5,114,023 s (59.2 d), was 9,596,113 s (111.1 d) from deployment.

incidents.name: ChainSwap MappingToken receive() unauthorised signatories
incidents.notes: The bridge's receive(fromChainId,to,nonce,volume,Signature[]) counted the supplied signature entries towards its threshold without checking that each signatory was an authorised bridge signer, so anyone could mint bridged tokens to themselves.

sources.ref: onchain review: proxy 0x089165ac9a7Bf61833Da86268F34A01652543466 created 2021-05-14T06:19:27Z by 0x6132d220feec1f83a9f0718a8bfd296a0ed67619, unrelated to attack sender 0xeda5066780de29d00dfb54581a707ef6f52d8113. It is a ChainSwap InitializableProductProxy: its EIP-1967 implementation slot is zero and it resolves code through IProxyFactory(factory).productImplementations(name), with factory 0xbf515ff38d55737c56d62e8b6a8eea322ec38aa5 (FACTORY_SLOT 0x7a45a402e4cb6e08ebc196f20f66d5d30e67285a2a8aa80503fa409e727a4af1) and name 'MappingToken' (NAME_SLOT 0x4cd9b827ca535ceb0880425d70eff88561ecdf04dc32fcf7ff3b15c587f8a870), so no EIP-1967 Upgraded event is ever emitted. Binary-searching eth_call of productImplementations('MappingToken') over [7395576, 9042275] gives 0x860da66ce2962233112d5f738bec5f14d865e690 at creation and 0xe92998f47118335ba33d1eba87282584f53519b5 from block 8935896 (2021-07-07T02:36:25Z) onwards, unchanged through the incident block (spot-checked at 8950000, 8990000, 9020000, 9042274 and 9042275; it moves again to 0x9c88ffe3779204154e33e4812a5a6507f37b6fea by block 9100000). The 2021-07-07 install is the fix deployed after the 2021-07-02 ChainSwap incident, so the code the attacker hit was three days old. Loss figure $4.4M from the ChainSec DeFi exploit timeline for the 10 July 2021 ChainSwap incident.
